---
id: king-penguin
title: King penguin
---
King penguins (*Aptenodytes patagonicus*) breed in dense colonies on
subantarctic islands. Adults fast for long stretches while a single chick
waits; the other parent forages in nearby seas. Countershaded plumage and
a fused tarsus suit underwater pursuit of fish and squid. Chicks form
crèches while both adults are at sea.
